rules.title: Misspelt SKOS or OWL mapping predicate
rules.suggestion: Use the exact SKOS or OWL mapping property IRI (for example skos:exactMatch); the asserted one is unknown.

rules.title: exactMatch chain conflicting with broadMatch, narrowMatch or relatedMatch
rules.suggestion: skos:exactMatch is transitive and disjoint with broad/narrowMatch; drop one mapping of the chain.

rules.title: Contradictory hierarchical or associative mapping strengths
rules.suggestion: Keep one mapping strength per pair: broadMatch, narrowMatch and relatedMatch exclude each other.

rules.title: Term with several distinct exactMatch targets in one namespace
rules.suggestion: Keep one exactMatch per target namespace, or relate the targets to each other if they are the same thing.

rules.title: Symmetric SKOS mapping asserted in one direction only
rules.suggestion: Assert the inverse skos:exactMatch/closeMatch too, since both terms are described in this file.

rules.title: Mapping between a class and a property
rules.suggestion: Map classes to classes and properties to properties; the declared kinds are incompatible.

rules.title: Mapping target outside the declared alignment namespaces
rules.suggestion: Map to a term inside one of alignment_namespaces, or add the target's namespace to the policy file.

rules.title: Duplicate mapping through several predicates
rules.suggestion: Keep the most precise mapping predicate; the same pair is related by several equivalent assertions.

rules.title: broadMatch or narrowMatch contradicting the asserted hierarchy
rules.suggestion: Reverse the mapping or fix the hierarchy; the file places the broader term below the narrower one.

rules.title: Declared mapping set without version, creator or licence
rules.suggestion: Add a version, a creator and a licence to the sssom:MappingSet.

rules.title: Mapping coverage below the expected ratio
rules.suggestion: Align more classes and properties (skos:exactMatch, owl:equivalentClass) or lower alignment_min_coverage.

rules.title: Disconnected class
rules.suggestion: Inspect whether the class is intentional: it has no sub/superclass or equivalence link, is not deprecated and is never used as a domain, range, restriction filler or type.

rules.title: Class without instances or subclasses
rules.suggestion: Check whether this class is intentionally uninstantiated, abstract, or imported.

rules.title: Asserted subclass cycle
rules.suggestion: Review the asserted subclass cycle; an OWL subclass cycle is not by itself inconsistent.

rules.title: Transitively redundant subclass axiom
rules.suggestion: Remove a redundant asserted subclass axiom if it adds no documentation value.

rules.title: Excessive hierarchy depth
rules.suggestion: Review unusually deep asserted hierarchy and possible re-modeling.

rules.title: Excessive direct superclasses
rules.suggestion: Review the intended meaning of multiple direct superclasses.

rules.title: Long single-child taxonomic chain
rules.suggestion: Check long single-child taxonomic chains for needless subdivisions.

rules.title: Class with excessive asserted properties
rules.suggestion: Consider splitting classes or using property groups/shapes where appropriate.

rules.title: Equivalent classes with identical labels
rules.suggestion: Check whether class equivalence is purposeful and not merely a duplicate name.

rules.title: Sibling classes with identical labels
rules.suggestion: Give each sibling class a distinct label, or merge the classes if they mean the same thing.

rules.title: Excessive direct subclasses
rules.suggestion: Introduce intermediate classes to structure a flat fan-out of direct subclasses.

rules.title: Instantiated class with only unused leaf subclasses
rules.suggestion: Check whether the unused leaf subclasses are needed or whether instances should use them.

rules.title: Miscellaneous remainder class
rules.suggestion: Replace the catch-all 'Other' subclass with specific classes or an open-world note on its parent.

rules.title: Class below two asserted-disjoint classes
rules.suggestion: Remove one of the superclass assertions or the disjointness; the class cannot have instances.

rules.title: Unlabelled class with several subclasses
rules.suggestion: Add an rdfs:label or skos:prefLabel to the class that heads a subtree.

rules.title: Generic is-a style property
rules.suggestion: Use rdfs:subClassOf or rdf:type, or a semantically specific property, instead of a generic 'is' property.

rules.title: Class also used as an individual
rules.suggestion: Check whether the class/individual punning is intended; otherwise model the individual separately.

rules.title: Redundant owl:Thing superclass
rules.suggestion: Drop the explicit owl:Thing or rdfs:Resource superclass; the class already has another superclass.

rules.title: Class asserted equal to or below owl:Nothing
rules.suggestion: Remove the owl:Nothing assertion or the class if it is not meant to be unsatisfiable.

rules.title: Subclass labelled like its superclass
rules.suggestion: Give the subclass a label that says how it specializes its superclass.

rules.title: Equivalent class that is also an asserted ancestor
rules.suggestion: Check whether the subclass chain between equivalent classes is intended; it collapses the chain.

rules.title: Class named like a property
rules.suggestion: Name classes with nouns; a has/is-style name usually denotes a property.

rules.title: Class name encodes a conjunction
rules.suggestion: Split the class, or use owl:unionOf / owl:intersectionOf instead of 'And'/'Or' in the name.

rules.title: Sibling class breaking the naming pattern
rules.suggestion: Check whether the class belongs under this parent or should follow its siblings' naming pattern.

rules.title: Instance typed with a class and its ancestor
rules.suggestion: Remove the redundant type assertion for the ancestor class.

rules.title: Value datatype conflicts with property range
rules.suggestion: Check a property assertion for range/type confusion.

rules.title: Property usage conflicts with subject type
rules.suggestion: Check a property assertion for datatype/object-property confusion.

rules.title: Literal whose lexical form is not valid for its datatype
rules.suggestion: Correct the value or its datatype ('2004'^^xsd:gYear, not xsd:date); type plain text as xsd:string.

rules.title: Datatype outside the OWL 2 datatype map
rules.suggestion: Use a datatype of the OWL 2 datatype map (xsd:dateTime rather than xsd:date), or rdfs:Literal.

rules.title: Reference to a deprecated term
rules.suggestion: Migrate non-annotation references to deprecated terms or justify them.

rules.title: Unpinned or invalid ontology import
rules.suggestion: Pin or resolve imported ontology versions in an explicit import manifest.

rules.title: Undeclared local vocabulary term
rules.suggestion: Review references to local undeclared vocabulary terms.

rules.title: Ontology without a contact or maintainer
rules.suggestion: Add a dcterms:publisher, dcat:contactPoint or foaf:maintainer so users know whom to contact.

rules.title: Deprecated term without a replacement or reason
rules.suggestion: Add dcterms:isReplacedBy or an obsolescence reason (rdfs:comment, skos:historyNote) to deprecated terms.

rules.title: Term without creator attribution
rules.suggestion: Add dcterms:creator or dcterms:contributor to the terms that lack attribution.

rules.title: Term without creation or modification date
rules.suggestion: Add dcterms:created or dcterms:modified to the terms that lack a date.

rules.title: Versioned ontology without change history
rules.suggestion: Record changes with skos:changeNote, vann:changes or owl:priorVersion.

rules.title: Term without a status
rules.suggestion: Add a status such as vs:term_status to the terms that lack one.

rules.title: Obsolete term still used in axioms
rules.suggestion: Replace references to owl:DeprecatedClass/owl:DeprecatedProperty terms or retire the referencing axiom.

rules.title: Term defined outside the base namespace
rules.suggestion: Move the definition to the owning vocabulary or keep only an import stub for external terms.

rules.title: Term missing the annotations the policy requires
rules.suggestion: Add the missing annotations, or drop them from required_annotations in the policy file.

rules.title: Versioned ontology without review or approval metadata
rules.suggestion: Record review or approval with dcterms:dateAccepted, schema:reviewedBy or pav:curatedBy.

rules.title: Policy file invalid or for a different policy-pack version
rules.suggestion: Remove or fix the unknown keys; the policy file only supports the documented keys and policy_version 1.

rules.title: Whitespace or non-absolute IRI
rules.suggestion: Use stable absolute IRIs; avoid whitespace in identifiers.

rules.title: Ontology IRI contains a file extension
rules.suggestion: Consider an extension-independent ontology identifier (policy-dependent).

rules.title: Local-name collision across namespaces
rules.suggestion: Check whether duplicate local identifiers across namespaces confuse users.

rules.title: Term namespaces unrelated to the ontology IRI
rules.suggestion: Mint term IRIs under the ontology IRI, or document why the namespace differs.

rules.title: Mixed hash and slash term namespaces
rules.suggestion: Use one namespace style (hash or slash) for the terms of a vocabulary.

rules.title: Term IRI contains a query string
rules.suggestion: Avoid '?query' parts in term IRIs; they are not stable identifiers.

rules.title: Mixed http and https term IRIs
rules.suggestion: Use a single URI scheme for the terms of one vocabulary.

rules.title: IRI contains characters that are not allowed
rules.suggestion: Remove or percent-encode characters such as < > " { } | \ ^ and backtick.

rules.title: Term IRI has an empty local name
rules.suggestion: Give the term a local name; an IRI ending in '#' or '/' names a namespace.

rules.title: Percent-encoded characters in a term local name
rules.suggestion: Prefer readable local names without percent escapes.

rules.title: Term IRI uses a loopback host
rules.suggestion: Publish terms under a resolvable, persistent host instead of localhost.

rules.title: Version or date embedded in a term IRI
rules.suggestion: Keep term IRIs persistent; put versions in owl:versionIRI instead.

rules.title: Leading, trailing or repeated separators in a local name
rules.suggestion: Avoid leading/trailing or doubled '_' and '-' in local names.

rules.title: Opaque and readable local names mixed in one namespace
rules.suggestion: Use one naming scheme per namespace: either opaque numeric identifiers or readable names.

rules.title: Ontology IRI has a query string or fragment
rules.suggestion: Use an ontology IRI without '?query' or '#fragment' parts.

rules.title: Ontology IRI also used as a term
rules.suggestion: Do not reuse the ontology IRI as a class, property, concept or individual.

rules.title: Placeholder ontology IRI
rules.suggestion: Give the ontology a permanent IRI under a namespace you control, such as a w3id.org or purl.org PURL.

rules.title: Declared prefix that no IRI uses
rules.suggestion: Remove the prefix declaration, or import the vocabulary it was declared for.

rules.title: Term without label
rules.suggestion: Add rdfs:label or an accepted alternative to the declared local term.

rules.title: Term without definition
rules.suggestion: Add a natural-language definition (rdfs:comment, skos:definition, or dcterms:description).

rules.title: Multiple labels in one language
rules.suggestion: Use one language-specific primary label per term and language.

rules.title: Duplicate label across terms
rules.suggestion: Differentiate labels or formally document and link genuinely equivalent concepts.

rules.title: Blank or whitespace-padded label
rules.suggestion: Trim whitespace or replace empty labels.

rules.title: Mixed plain and language-tagged labels
rules.suggestion: Use a consistent label language-tag policy.

rules.title: Mixed identifier naming styles
rules.suggestion: Use one configured naming convention for comparable term identifiers.

rules.title: Missing label in a required language
rules.suggestion: Add the required preferred language label.

rules.title: Label capitalization inconsistent with term kind
rules.suggestion: Review capitalization and wording relative to the namespace policy.

rules.title: Label is a verbatim identifier
rules.suggestion: Write a human-readable label (words separated by spaces) instead of repeating the identifier.

rules.title: Label contains line breaks, tabs or repeated whitespace
rules.suggestion: Use single spaces inside labels.

rules.title: Label ends with punctuation
rules.suggestion: Remove trailing punctuation such as '.', ':', ';' or ',' from labels.

rules.title: Label or definition is not a literal
rules.suggestion: Use a literal value for labels and definitions; link resources with a different property.

rules.title: Label literal has a non-string datatype
rules.suggestion: Use plain or language-tagged string literals for labels.

rules.title: Alternative label repeats the preferred label
rules.suggestion: Remove alternative labels that equal the term's own label in the same language.

rules.title: Alternative label is another term's label
rules.suggestion: Resolve the overlap: relate the terms or remove the conflicting synonym.

rules.title: Definition repeats the label
rules.suggestion: Write a definition that says more than the label.

rules.title: Label contains markup or character entities
rules.suggestion: Store labels as plain text; remove HTML/XML tags and character entities.

rules.title: Blank definition
rules.suggestion: Provide definition text or remove the empty annotation.

rules.title: Identical definition on several terms
rules.suggestion: Write a distinguishing definition for each term.

rules.title: Label is not Unicode NFC-normalized
rules.suggestion: Normalize labels to Unicode NFC so equal-looking labels compare equal.

rules.title: Label in a language outside the configured languages
rules.suggestion: Use a configured language tag or extend the language policy.

rules.title: Missing definition in a required language
rules.suggestion: Add the definition in every configured language, or none.

rules.title: Several skos:definition values in one language
rules.suggestion: Keep one skos:definition per language and term.

rules.title: Whitespace-padded annotation value
rules.suggestion: Trim the leading and trailing whitespace of the annotation value.

rules.title: Pattern library index entry names no member ontology
rules.suggestion: Give the entry the member's ontology IRI, or link it to the member (for example with rdfs:isDefinedBy).

rules.title: Pattern library member missing from the index
rules.suggestion: Add an index entry for the pattern ontology, or remove the file from the library.

rules.title: Pattern library member refers to a pattern the library lacks
rules.suggestion: Correct the IRI, or add the pattern ontology it names to the library.

rules.title: Low class label coverage
rules.suggestion: Add an rdfs:label or skos:prefLabel to the unlabelled classes.

rules.title: Low class definition coverage
rules.suggestion: Add rdfs:comment, skos:definition or dcterms:description to the undefined classes.

rules.title: Low property documentation coverage
rules.suggestion: Document properties with rdfs:comment, skos:definition or dcterms:description.

rules.title: High mean class fan-out
rules.suggestion: Introduce intermediate classes where parents have many direct subclasses on average.

rules.title: High orphan class ratio
rules.suggestion: Connect orphan classes to the hierarchy, properties or instances, or remove them.

rules.title: Low property-to-class ratio
rules.suggestion: Check whether relations between the classes are missing; the ontology may be only a taxonomy.

rules.title: High property-to-class ratio
rules.suggestion: Check for property proliferation: generalise properties or add the classes they should describe.

rules.title: Low property signature coverage
rules.suggestion: Declare rdfs:domain or rdfs:range on object and datatype properties where the intent is clear.

rules.title: Low label language-tag coverage
rules.suggestion: Tag labels with their language (for example rdfs:label "x"@en).

rules.title: High cross-namespace reference ratio
rules.suggestion: Check that the ontology is not mostly a thin layer over external vocabularies; consider importing instead.

rules.title: Excessive number of imports
rules.suggestion: Reduce owl:imports to the ontologies actually needed, or use import modules.

rules.title: Terse class definitions
rules.suggestion: Expand very short class definitions so that they state what distinguishes the class.

rules.title: High blank node ratio
rules.suggestion: Check whether anonymous resources could be named, or are restrictions that should be reviewed.

rules.title: Quality budget breached
rules.suggestion: Bring the measurement within its quality_budgets bound, or change the budget in the policy file.

rules.title: Missing ontology declaration
rules.suggestion: Declare a stable ontology IRI using rdf:type owl:Ontology.

rules.title: Multiple ontology declarations
rules.suggestion: Prefer one primary owl:Ontology declaration per standalone ontology document.

rules.title: Missing ontology license
rules.suggestion: Add dcterms:license (or an agreed equivalent) to the ontology.

rules.title: Missing ontology version
rules.suggestion: Add owl:versionIRI or owl:versionInfo according to your release policy.

rules.title: Missing ontology creator or creation date
rules.suggestion: Add creator and creation date provenance (e.g. dcterms:creator and dcterms:created).

rules.title: Missing ontology description
rules.suggestion: Describe the ontology with dcterms:description or rdfs:comment.

rules.title: Ontology or version IRI declared by several documents with different content
rules.suggestion: Keep one document per release: remove the stale copy, give every release its own version IRI, and give a fork its own ontology IRI.

rules.title: Identical copies of one ontology in several documents
rules.suggestion: Keep one copy, or generate the others from it (robot mirror, a release step) so they cannot drift apart.

rules.title: Imported file does not declare the imported IRI
rules.suggestion: Correct the catalog entry (or the owl:imports IRI) so the file declares the imported IRI, or give the file that ontology or version IRI.

rules.title: Undeclared class in subclass axiom
rules.suggestion: Explicitly declare local classes used in class axioms.

rules.title: Undeclared property in domain or range axiom
rules.suggestion: Explicitly declare local properties used in schema axioms.

rules.title: Property typed as both object and datatype property
rules.suggestion: Do not simultaneously declare a property as both owl:ObjectProperty and owl:DatatypeProperty.

rules.title: Multiple domains or ranges mean intersection
rules.suggestion: Review conjunction semantics of multiple rdfs:domain/rdfs:range; use owl:unionOf if intended.

rules.title: Property without domain
rules.suggestion: Consider declaring domain or explaining why a global domain is inappropriate.

rules.title: Property without range
rules.suggestion: Consider declaring range or explaining why a global range is inappropriate.

rules.title: Property declared inverse of itself
rules.suggestion: Replace self-inverse modeling with owl:SymmetricProperty when this is intentional.

rules.title: Symmetric property also declared with an inverse
rules.suggestion: Review redundant or unintended inverse axioms on symmetric properties.

rules.title: Datatype property with object-property characteristic
rules.suggestion: Use object properties for owl:inverseOf and symmetric/transitive property semantics.

rules.title: Property chain with fewer than two operands
rules.suggestion: Review an owl:propertyChainAxiom whose RDF list has only one element.

rules.title: Universal restriction without existence
rules.suggestion: Check intended allValuesFrom semantics; it does not imply existence of a value.

rules.title: Class equivalent to itself
rules.suggestion: Review the use of owl:equivalentClass on the class itself.

rules.title: Object property asserted with a literal value
rules.suggestion: An object-property assertion should point to a resource, not a literal.

rules.title: Datatype property asserted with a resource value
rules.suggestion: A datatype-property assertion should point to a literal.

rules.title: Undeclared local predicate
rules.suggestion: Declare a local predicate as a property (or exclude it from schema-only policy).

rules.title: Reflexivity characteristic on datatype property
rules.suggestion: Remove owl:ReflexiveProperty/owl:IrreflexiveProperty; they apply to object properties only.

rules.title: Property both symmetric and asymmetric
rules.suggestion: Keep only one of owl:SymmetricProperty and owl:AsymmetricProperty; together they leave the property empty.

rules.title: Reflexive property also irreflexive or asymmetric
rules.suggestion: Remove the contradictory characteristic; a reflexive property cannot be irreflexive or asymmetric.

rules.title: Non-simple property in simple-property axiom
rules.suggestion: Drop functional, inverse-functional, irreflexive or asymmetric from transitive or chain-defined properties.

rules.title: Property subPropertyOf cycle
rules.suggestion: Break the owl:subPropertyOf cycle or replace it with owl:equivalentProperty if the properties are equivalent.

rules.title: Sub-property or equivalent property of a different kind
rules.suggestion: Relate object properties only to object properties and datatype properties only to datatype properties.

rules.title: Property range conflicts with property kind
rules.suggestion: Use datatype ranges for datatype properties and class ranges for object properties.

rules.title: Property with several distinct inverses
rules.suggestion: Review owl:inverseOf axioms; distinct inverses of one property are equivalent to each other.

rules.title: Disjoint properties that are sub-property or equivalent
rules.suggestion: Remove the disjointness or the sub-property/equivalence axiom; the property can have no assertions.

rules.title: Disjoint classes that are subclass or equivalent
rules.suggestion: Remove the disjointness or the subclass/equivalence axiom; the class cannot have instances.

rules.title: Individuals both same and different
rules.suggestion: Remove either the owl:sameAs or the owl:differentFrom assertion; the ontology is inconsistent.

rules.title: Negative property assertion contradicts a positive assertion
rules.suggestion: Remove the NegativePropertyAssertion or the contradicting positive triple.

rules.title: Irreflexive property used reflexively
rules.suggestion: Remove the assertion relating an individual to itself or drop owl:IrreflexiveProperty.

rules.title: Asymmetric property asserted in both directions
rules.suggestion: Remove one direction (or a self-assertion) or drop owl:AsymmetricProperty.

rules.title: Illegal punning of declaration kinds
rules.suggestion: Do not declare one IRI as both class and datatype, or as annotation property and object/datatype property.

rules.title: Malformed or empty class-expression list
rules.suggestion: Give owl:unionOf, owl:intersectionOf, owl:oneOf and owl:disjointUnionOf a well-formed, non-empty RDF list.

rules.title: Single-operand union, intersection or disjoint union
rules.suggestion: Replace an owl:unionOf or owl:intersectionOf with one operand by that operand.

rules.title: Duplicate operand in class-expression list
rules.suggestion: Remove the repeated member from the owl:unionOf, owl:intersectionOf or owl:oneOf list.

rules.title: Restriction with missing or invalid owl:onProperty
rules.suggestion: Give every owl:Restriction exactly one owl:onProperty (or owl:onProperties) pointing to a property.

rules.title: Restriction without exactly one valid constraint
rules.suggestion: Add an owl:someValuesFrom, owl:allValuesFrom, owl:hasValue, owl:hasSelf or cardinality constraint.

rules.title: Invalid cardinality restriction
rules.suggestion: Use a non-negative integer for cardinalities and add owl:onClass/owl:onDataRange to qualified ones.

rules.title: Minimum cardinality exceeds maximum cardinality
rules.suggestion: Make the lower cardinality bound at most the upper bound within one restriction.

rules.title: Existential restriction on owl:Nothing
rules.suggestion: Remove the restriction or use a satisfiable filler; no individual can be an instance of owl:Nothing.

rules.title: Vacuous restriction
rules.suggestion: Remove a restriction that every individual satisfies (allValuesFrom owl:Thing, minimum cardinality 0).

rules.title: Restriction mixes object and datatype property kinds
rules.suggestion: Use class fillers and resources with object properties, and datatypes and literals with datatype properties.

rules.title: Contradictory owl:complementOf cycle
rules.suggestion: Break the odd-length owl:complementOf cycle; a class cannot be the complement of itself.

rules.title: Class subclass of or equivalent to its own complement
rules.suggestion: Remove the axiom relating a class to its own owl:complementOf expression.

rules.title: Contradictory or tautological operands in union or intersection
rules.suggestion: Review an intersection of complements/disjoint classes or a union of a class and its complement.

rules.title: Individuals identical through owl:sameAs chains but asserted different
rules.suggestion: Remove the conflicting owl:sameAs or owl:differentFrom assertion; nothing differs from itself.

rules.title: Malformed owl:AllDifferent or owl:AllDisjointClasses
rules.suggestion: Give the axiom one well-formed member list with at least two distinct members.

rules.title: Deeply nested or very long blank-node structure
rules.suggestion: Flatten the structure or give intermediate nodes IRIs; recursive consumers can exhaust their stack on it.

rules.title: Unreasonably large literal value
rules.suggestion: Store large payloads outside the ontology and reference them by IRI.

rules.title: owl:imports not followed
rules.suggestion: Map the imports to local files with --follow-imports and a catalog-v001.xml (or --catalog), or put local copies in a folder (for example with robot mirror) and pass --import-dir; ontolint never fetches imports from the network. Use --ignore SEC007 to silence this note.

rules.title: IRI with an unsafe scheme
rules.suggestion: Use http(s), urn or another resolvable-by-design scheme instead of file:, javascript:, data: or similar.

rules.title: Control or bidirectional-override characters
rules.suggestion: Remove control and bidirectional-override characters; they can disguise the text a reader sees.

rules.title: Credentials embedded in an IRI
rules.suggestion: Remove the user:password@ part of the IRI and rotate the exposed credential; the report masks it, so find it at the SARIF region or in the source.

rules.title: User name embedded in an IRI
rules.suggestion: Remove the user@ part of the IRI; if it is a token, rotate it and keep it out of the ontology. The report masks it, so find it at the SARIF region or in the source.

rules.title: OWL profile violation reported by ROBOT
rules.suggestion: Correct the reported OWL profile violations, or select the intended OWL profile.

rules.title: SHACL validation violation
rules.suggestion: Fix the supplied SHACL shapes or data, and inspect the SHACL report.

rules.title: Property shape without sh:name
rules.suggestion: Add sh:name to property shapes to support generated forms and documentation.

rules.title: Property shape without sh:description
rules.suggestion: Add sh:description to non-trivial property shapes.

rules.title: Constraint-bearing shape without sh:message
rules.suggestion: Add sh:message to constraint-bearing shapes for better diagnostics.

rules.title: Node shape without label or comment
rules.suggestion: Add label and comment to published node shapes.

rules.title: Multiple shape annotations in one language
rules.suggestion: Use one annotation per language for each SHACL name/description/message.

rules.title: Instantiated class without shape target
rules.suggestion: Add a shape targeting this class, or exempt it from data-quality validation.

rules.title: Shape with sh:minCount greater than sh:maxCount
rules.suggestion: Make sh:minCount <= sh:maxCount.

rules.title: Cardinality or length value is not a non-negative xsd:integer
rules.suggestion: Use a non-negative xsd:integer.

rules.title: sh:in list that is empty or repeats members
rules.suggestion: Remove duplicate members; an empty sh:in list can never be satisfied.

rules.title: sh:languageIn with a malformed language tag
rules.suggestion: List well-formed BCP 47 language tags as plain literals, for example "en" or "fr-CA".

rules.title: Invalid sh:pattern regular expression
rules.suggestion: Fix the sh:pattern expression (and sh:flags) so it compiles.

rules.title: sh:uniqueLang on a shape with a non-language-tagged datatype or outside a property shape
rules.suggestion: Drop sh:uniqueLang or use sh:datatype rdf:langString; other datatypes never carry a language tag. Put sh:uniqueLang in a property shape (one with sh:path).

rules.title: Shape combining sh:datatype and sh:class
rules.suggestion: Remove one: a literal cannot be an instance of a class, so the shape cannot be satisfied.

rules.title: sh:severity outside the SHACL severity vocabulary or with several values
rules.suggestion: Give a shape one sh:severity: sh:Info, sh:Warning or sh:Violation, or a custom IRI outside sh:.

rules.title: Invalid sh:flags value or sh:flags without sh:pattern
rules.suggestion: Use only the flags s, m, i, x and q, and put sh:flags next to the sh:pattern it modifies.

rules.title: Shape that is part of a recursive reference cycle
rules.suggestion: Break the cycle: recursive shape references have implementation-defined validation behaviour.

rules.title: Shape with sh:minLength greater than sh:maxLength
rules.suggestion: Make sh:minLength <= sh:maxLength.

rules.title: Shape with an empty numeric range
rules.suggestion: Make the lower bound smaller than the upper bound (min/max Inclusive/Exclusive).

rules.title: sh:node or sh:property refers to an undefined shape
rules.suggestion: Define the referenced shape in the shapes graph or correct the IRI.

rules.title: Deactivated shape left in the shapes graph
rules.suggestion: Remove the shape or re-enable it; sh:deactivated true silently disables validation.

rules.title: Node shape that is neither targeted nor referenced
rules.suggestion: Add a target (for example sh:targetClass) or reference the shape from another shape.

rules.title: Shape target value that is not an IRI
rules.suggestion: Use an IRI for sh:targetClass, sh:targetSubjectsOf and sh:targetObjectsOf.

rules.title: Property shape without exactly one sh:path
rules.suggestion: Give every property shape exactly one sh:path.

rules.title: Closed shape that does not ignore rdf:type
rules.suggestion: Add rdf:type to sh:ignoredProperties, otherwise every typed focus node violates the closed shape.

rules.title: sh:and, sh:or or sh:xone with fewer than two members
rules.suggestion: Inline the single member or add the missing alternatives; an empty sh:or can never hold.

rules.title: Node shape with several property shapes for the same path
rules.suggestion: Merge the property shapes that constrain the same sh:path.

rules.title: Shape targets a local class the ontology does not declare
rules.suggestion: Fix the sh:targetClass IRI or declare the class in the ontology.

rules.title: Multiple preferred labels in one language
rules.suggestion: Keep only one skos:prefLabel per language tag for a given resource.

rules.title: Same literal in disjoint SKOS label properties
rules.suggestion: Do not reuse the same literal across prefLabel, altLabel and hiddenLabel of one resource.

rules.title: Cycle in skos:broader hierarchy
rules.suggestion: Inspect hierarchical cycles; SKOS does not universally prohibit them.

rules.title: Concept without preferred label
rules.suggestion: Give a concept a preferred label in your supported language(s).

rules.title: Concept not in a concept scheme
rules.suggestion: Use skos:Concept with skos:inScheme and an appropriate scheme policy.

rules.title: Top concept with a broader concept
rules.suggestion: Review whether a scheme top concept should also have a broader concept.

rules.title: Resource typed as both skos:Concept and skos:ConceptScheme
rules.suggestion: Split the resource: skos:Concept and skos:ConceptScheme are disjoint classes.

rules.title: skos:Collection typed as concept or concept scheme
rules.suggestion: Do not type a skos:Collection as skos:Concept or skos:ConceptScheme; the classes are disjoint.

rules.title: skos:related between concepts that are also hierarchically linked
rules.suggestion: Remove skos:related or the broader/narrower link: associative and hierarchical relations are disjoint.

rules.title: Concept related to itself
rules.suggestion: Remove the reflexive skos:related statement.

rules.title: SKOS mapping property between concepts of the same scheme
rules.suggestion: Use skos:broader/narrower/related inside a scheme; reserve mapping properties for cross-scheme links.

rules.title: skos:exactMatch combined with broadMatch, narrowMatch or relatedMatch
rules.suggestion: Keep one mapping type per concept pair: skos:exactMatch is disjoint with broad/narrow/relatedMatch.

rules.title: SKOS label that is not a plain or language-tagged string literal
rules.suggestion: Use a plain or language-tagged string literal for skos:prefLabel, altLabel and hiddenLabel.

rules.title: SKOS label that is empty or has surrounding whitespace
rules.suggestion: Trim the label and do not leave it empty.

rules.title: Concept scheme with concepts but no top concept
rules.suggestion: Declare entry points with skos:hasTopConcept or skos:topConceptOf.

rules.title: SKOS relation with a literal value
rules.suggestion: SKOS semantic, mapping and scheme relations link resources; replace the literal with an IRI.

rules.title: SKOS relation to an undescribed local resource
rules.suggestion: Describe the target concept in the vocabulary or correct the link.

rules.title: Redundant skos:broader shortcut
rules.suggestion: Remove the direct broader link that is already implied through an asserted intermediate concept (vocabularies with a parallel classification keep such shortcuts on purpose: use --ignore SKOS018).

rules.title: Hierarchical link between concepts of different schemes
rules.suggestion: Keep broader/narrower inside one scheme and use mapping properties across schemes.

rules.title: Same skos:notation on several concepts of one scheme
rules.suggestion: Make notations unique within a concept scheme.

rules.title: Same preferred label on several concepts of one scheme
rules.suggestion: Give concepts of one scheme distinguishable preferred labels per language.
